name: Market-Making Games
description: Quote two-sided prices on unknown quantities and update them as trades arrive.

lessonNames.l2-dice-sum: The fair value of a dice sum
lessonNames.l8-informed-flow: When the other side knows more
lessonNames.l13-full-game: A full game with a partner

lessonObjectives.l1-unknown-quantity: Give a fair value and a range for a quantity you cannot look up.
lessonObjectives.l2-dice-sum: Price a dice outcome by its expectation.
lessonObjectives.l3-how-wide: Set the width of a quote from your uncertainty.
lessonObjectives.l4-fermi: Estimate a quantity by breaking it into parts you can guess.
lessonObjectives.l5-two-sided: Quote a bid and an offer around your fair value.
lessonObjectives.l6-edge: Compute the expected edge of a trade at your price.
lessonObjectives.l7-skewing: Move your quote after being lifted or hit.
lessonObjectives.l8-informed-flow: Widen your quotes against a counterparty who may be informed.
lessonObjectives.l9-cards-revealed: Update a quote as cards are revealed one by one.
lessonObjectives.l10-position-limits: Manage inventory under a position limit.
lessonObjectives.l11-hedging: Hedge exposure with a correlated instrument.
lessonObjectives.l12-thinking-aloud: Explain each quote as you make it.
lessonObjectives.l13-full-game: Run a full market-making game and review every trade.
